x-provenance.recorded-by: Lenticule Science Senior and Red Cup Engineer Senior (pass kalshi-markets of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus)
x-provenance.basis: The raised-by and asks fields are the Leader's own words from the cited utterances; the requirements are the EARS rendering of what those words ask and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group's Kalshi activity runs as a typed Area of the Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance with Characters, pulses, heartbeats and ticks, on a host that is not the Leader's laptop, with systemd, memory, CPU and network reached only through their engineering services sections.

requirements.says: The Kalshi services section shall be a typed Resource and Area of MetroPlat with Characters, pulses, heartbeats and ticks.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "a Kalshi Services Section as a real typed Resource, a real Area, with Characters, pulses, heartbeats, ticks".

requirements.says: The Kalshi services section shall carry its scheduled activity as AOE pulses through FeltOS into MetroPlat and shall define no systemd timer of its own.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "I NEVER WANTED FUCKING SYSTEMD TIMERS FOR KALSHI WHY THE FUCK NO AOE PULSE?".

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog services section shall be the one section that hires the systemd engineering services section to provide the machine's systemd, and shall likewise hire the memory, CPU and network engineering services sections.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "THERE IS MEANT TO BE ONE ... bare cedar fog services section it hires systemd engineering services section ... same for Memory cpu network".

requirements.says: Each services section shall be a micro-enterprise in its machine's services section, and the Bare Cedar Fog services section shall be a micro-enterprise on the Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "every services section is meant to be a micro-enterprise in its machines services section".

requirements.says: The Kalshi services section shall hold its data as SignCells, SignChains and SignGraphs.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "ALLLLLLL data is meant to be SignCells, SignChains, SignGraphs".

requirements.says: The Kalshi pulses shall run on a web server or on the Cold Red Gate MetroPlat instance and shall continue when the Leader's laptop reboots.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "ticks or pulses under our local metroplat instance, or even better, on some Web server not my laptop"; "Cold Red Gate is meant to host a MetroPlat instance".

requirements.says: The FeltOS area that carries Kalshi shall meet and then beat FluffOS as a world server for typed Areas and Characters.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "FeltOS, that I say should meet then beat FluffOS".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall be owned by the Kalshi engineering services section under Red Cup Engineering and shall not be locked in a local monorepo.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "where is our kalshi-engineering-services-section repo under red cup engineering"; "not just, locked in this local monorepo".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall be running, autonomous, fully functioning and improving how it works so that it applies better strategies over its arena.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-10-05: "ensure that our Kalshi stuff is running, autonomously, fully functioning, and improving how it works, so it can apply better strategies over its arena".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system's work method for planning, research and coding shall follow the Group's designed method for each class of work.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "you are not following ANY method we have designed, for ANY class of work: planning, research, coding".
